china-1926-7:p0281_1.rationale: Table gives the value of China's direct imports from and exports to each country (Hongkong, Macao, Indo-China, Siam, etc.) for 1920-24.

china-1926-7:p0282_1.rationale: Direct trade values by country (Turkey, Great Britain, northern Europe), imports and exports, 1920-24.

china-1926-7:p0283_1.rationale: Continuation of direct trade by country (Danzig, Germany, Netherlands, etc.), with totals, imports and exports for 1922-24.

china-1926-7:p0283_2.rationale: Direct trade values with Danzig through Portugal, imports and exports, 1920-22.

china-1926-7:p0284_1.rationale: Direct trade by country (Switzerland to South Africa) with imports, exports, totals and a closing summary including re-exports deducted from total imports to give net imports.

china-1926-7:p0287_1.rationale: Whole trade of each port, split into net foreign imports, net Chinese imports and exports, 1923-24. Treaty-port system is not itself the table's subject, so no treaty-ports tag.

china-1926-7:p0290_1.rationale: Continuation of whole trade of each port with net foreign imports, net Chinese imports, exports and port totals, 1923-24.

china-1926-7:p0291_1.rationale: Continuation of port trade values (Kongmoon to Szemao) by net foreign imports, net Chinese imports and exports, 1923-24.

china-1926-7:p0292_1.rationale: Final port (Tengyueh) and national grand totals of foreign imports, Chinese imports and exports, including exports abroad and home trade.

china-1926-7:p0293_1.rationale: Re-exports of foreign goods by destination country and Hongkong, 1923-24.
